atomo.title: Next-generation fuel projects get US federal funding
atomo.summary: Eight nuclear fuel technology projects have been selected to receive a share of up to USD50 million of federal funding under a US Department of Energy programme to support R&D to deliver TRU fuel technologies.

atomo.title: Uganda and Russia look to move ahead with nuclear project
atomo.summary: A roadmap setting out cooperation in the peaceful uses of nuclear energy, as part of work towards a nuclear power plant, has been signed by Russia and Uganda.
